findings.finding: VREF = +5VA/2 through 470R/470R + 10 uF (68 Hz corner) reaches MAIN at gain 1 in the difference stage, then the TPA3220 at 24 dB; +5V dips from Wi-Fi bursts become speaker ticks; shared VREF also limits L/R separation to 47.6 dB at 1 kHz, 29.7 dB at 100 Hz.
findings.evidence: sims/audio/tb_vref_dip_asbuilt.cir: 10 mV 1 ms dip on +5V -> 27.0 mVpp at speaker (bound 2 mVpp, fail); tb_vref_xtalk_asbuilt: sep 47.6 dB @1k, 29.7 dB @100 Hz; check_audio_nets.py FAIL 'VREF corner 67.7 Hz'
findings.reference_design: TI single-supply op-amp practice and K2M I/V boards decouple/buffer the mid-rail reference far below the audio band
findings.fix: C64 10 uF -> 100 uF 6.3 V X5R 1206 (LCSC C15008, basic; verify stock): 3.5 mVpp tick, separation 67.6/47.6 dB, DJ-direct 0.09 mVpp. Optional: C219/C221/C317/C319 low end to VREF (DAC path 0 mVpp in sim; DJ-direct 3.4 mVpp).
findings.margin: as built 13x over the 2 mVpp bound per 10 mV dip; scales 2.7 mVpp per mV

findings.finding: ES8388 LOUT2/ROUT2 sit at VMID 1.65 V; C47/C48 10 uF couple them to the sub RCA with no mute. On power loss the 1.65 V collapses in ~2 ms and the step reaches the (separately powered) subwoofer: full-scale thump at every unplug.
findings.evidence: sims/audio/tb_lite_sub_thump_asbuilt.cir: -1.61 V at a 10k sub input (bound 0.14 V, fail) vs 1.41 Vpk 0 dBFS; check_audio_nets.py FAIL 'no mute on SUB_L/SUB_R'
findings.reference_design: ESP32-LyraT drives LOUT2/ROUT2 only into an on-board PA powered with the codec; line outs to external amplifiers carry a mute
findings.fix: Power-fail mute: 2x MMBT3904 (C20526) inverted mode on SUB_L/SUB_R (C to GND, E to SUB_x, 10k base) driven by MMBT3906 (C2910, verify) from a 47 uF reservoir charged via 1N4148W (C81598, verify) from +5V, base 10k to +5V, 100k collector pull-down: mutes at +5V < ~4.0 V, before LP5907 drops out at ~3.35 V. Sim tb_lite_sub_thump_fix_mute: 35 mV.

findings.finding: In DJ-direct (FLX4) the core's sub outputs are silent: the PCM5102A gets only squeezelite's mains sum (board_core.c hifi_bsp_audio) and the ES7243E is never configured (HIFI_HAS_CAPTURE 0). With 16-bit I2S BCLK is 32 fs, below the ES7243E's 64 fs minimum, so its init must use MCLK_SEL=BCLK and MULT_PRE x8.
findings.evidence: firmware/components/hifi/esp/board_core.c lines 106-123, 210-288; hifi_board_core.h HIFI_HAS_CAPTURE 0; ES7243E rev 5.0 sec. 3 and reg 0x02/0x04; PCM5102A SLAS859C table 11 (32 fs ok)
findings.reference_design: firmware-requirements C5 already assumes an ADC->sub path in DJ mode
findings.fix: Firmware: ES7243E init (REG02 MCLK_SEL=1, REG04 MULT_PRE=3, slave I2S 16-bit), I2S0 RX on GPIO36, route ADC to the sub DSP path in DJ-direct (inverted per C5). No board change.
findings.margin: functional gap: 0 output on the subs in DJ-direct

findings.finding: The round-1 AUDIO-6 caps (LI2LOVOL -3 dB, LOUT1 -4.5 dB) plus AUDIO-7's 15k/10k divider limit Lite DJ-direct to 5.4 Vrms (~5 W/6 ohm), 7.8 dB under clip.
findings.evidence: check_audio_nets.py: FLX4 2.1 Vrms -> 0.646 Vrms at LIN1 (Rin 20k, ES8388 ds 8.3) -> 5.4 Vrms vs 13.4 Vrms clip; ES8388 reg 39 table
findings.fix: Firmware, DJ-direct only: LI2LOVOL 0 dB (bits 5:3=010), LOUT1/ROUT1 code 29 (-1.5 dB): 10.9 Vrms, 1.8 dB under clip at 2.1 Vrms.

findings.finding: Lite firmware scale constants stale: LINE_DIVIDER 2.0 (loaded 3.25), TAP_DIVIDER 11 (loaded 16.0), HIFI_HAS_TAPS 0 though the taps are fitted, ADC FS 0.9 Vrms (datasheet 1.0 Vrms). Requirements L6/L7 not done.
findings.fix: Update the constants (3.25, 16.0, 1.41 Vpk), default HIFI_HAS_TAPS 1.

findings.finding: No RF shunt at the core RCA line-in (Lite has C42/C45 100 pF): the cable picks up the ESP32's +20 dBm 2.4 GHz and the U20/U14/ES7243E/TPA3220 inputs rectify it (TDMA-style buzz).
findings.reference_design: Lite C42/C45 100 pF at the RCA
findings.fix: 100 pF C0G 0402 (LCSC C1546) LIN_L/LIN_R to GND at J5; optional 1 nF at LDIV_x (68 kHz).

findings.finding: RCA sleeves are hard on board GND; with an earthed laptop (FLX4) and an earthed sub, the board closes an earth loop: 10 mV earth difference -> ~1 mV across the FLX4 cable shield (-66 dB re 2 Vrms), ~6 mV hum at the speaker in core DJ-direct. Class-II chargers and subs (the common case) give uV only.
findings.evidence: calc: I = 10 mV/~1 ohm loop, 0.1 ohm shield; DJ gain 0.37 x 15.85
findings.reference_design: pseudo-differential (ground-sensing) unbalanced inputs per common pro-audio practice
findings.fix: Core contingency: C102/C112 (AINxN) to a J5-sleeve sense net through a mirrored 4.7k/4.7k, plus a 0603 lift footprint J5 sleeve to GND (fit 0R, option 10R). Lite: document; recommend a USB isolator for the FLX4.

findings.finding: PCM5102A CPVDD/AVDD/DVDD have 1 uF each vs TI's 10 uF + 0.1 uF; the charge pump shares +3V3A with the ES9018K2M AVCC (whose output scales with AVCC).
findings.evidence: TI SLAS859C fig. 10.1.1; check_audio_nets.py WARN; core +3V3A total 6.3 uF of the LP5907's 10 uF max
findings.reference_design: TI typical application 10 uF + 0.1 uF per supply
findings.fix: Add 100 nF 0402 at C68/C69; option: CPVDD from +3V3 via 0603 ferrite + 10 uF (off the LP5907).

findings.finding: PCM5102A XSMT = DAC_EN follows +3V3 down on power loss; TI recommends XSMT watch the pre-regulated rail so the mute starts before the LDO rail goes.
findings.reference_design: XSMT divider from the SMPS rail
findings.fix: Optional: 100k/47k from +5V to XSMT OR-ed with DAC_EN via BAT54; else accept (ground-centred output, 'some pop').

findings.finding: An EN reset drives K2M RESETB low and its outputs hard to ground: 1.65 V CM step x ~1.3 % CM gain ~ 21 mV at MAIN, ~0.3 V at the speaker during the amps' 20 ms ramp-down. A panic/WDT reboot doesn't reset the TCA9539.
findings.evidence: ES9018K2M v3.7 pin table 'Driven to ground'; difference-amp CM gain for 1 % resistors
findings.reference_design: ESS standby sequence: soft_start=0 then RESETB
findings.fix: Firmware: before an intentional DAC_EN low, reg 14 soft_start=0 and amps in reset.

findings.finding: Loaded tap ratio from board values 0.0265 vs firmware requirement C6's 0.0276 (4 %).

Level budget passes: core 0 dBFS 15.8 Vrms (22.4 Vpk) vs 26.5 Vpk clip; OPA1678 out 1.03..3.86 V vs 0.8..4.3 V; + input 2.68 V vs 3.10 V; FLX4 2.1 Vrms -> core ADC -2.1 dBFS, DJ 11.6 Vrms; Lite LIN1 -3.8 dBFS, DAC path 11.9 vs 13.4 Vrms.
findings.reference_design: ES9018K2M v3.7 p.31; OPA1678 6.5; TPA3220 SLASEN3B tables 2/3
